outcome: Two medium method fixes recommended before outcome study; one low retention clarification

findings.title: Paired Wald interval collapses to false certainty at boundary samples
findings.evidence: pairedDifference with 500 identical pairs yields [0,0]; 500 improvements yields [1,1]. The variance formula is correct for an asymptotic Wald approximation, but that approximation has a boundary-coverage failure. At true improvement probability .001 and no worsening, probability of seeing zero improvements in 500 pairs is .6063789448611847; the reported [0,0] then excludes the true nonzero effect.
findings.recommendation: Before any outcome study, choose/document a nondegenerate score or conservative exact bound for paired differences, or a principled conservative boundary fallback. Update preregistration and tests rather than silently changing the method after outcomes.

findings.title: Censored comparisons can retain a target match in heldout results
findings.evidence: Censored paired observations are converted to 0. assessTarget has no censorship input and can return match for a synthetic 500-pair sample containing 50 unresolved pairs, fight incapacitations200 and escapes450. The training recommendation globally checks censorship; holdout always returns heldout-no-selection while its comparisons still expose the target match.
findings.recommendation: Retain every row and denominator, but mark confirmatory comparisons inconclusive when their relevant trial arms contain censorship, in either partition. Distinguish observed standing-at-cap from terminal standing survival in descriptive outputs. Add an explicit censored-target regression without running the full study.

findings.title: Report retains aggregate hashes rather than individual seed-level digests promised in prose
findings.evidence: combatSummary emits one replay_digest over all {trial,digest} rows and one full-row digest; runStudy discards individual combat rows. PREREGISTRATION says to keep the exact seed-level digest. A later audit must rerun source to inspect any one seed.
findings.recommendation: Either retain a seed-level manifest/NDJSON companion with a report hash, or state accurately that only aggregate commitments plus deterministic regeneration inputs are retained.

known_change_pending.fingerprint: Baseline CLI omits imported old schemas, manifests and preregistration prose. Parent reports author is already improving fingerprint coverage; this known pending change was not claimed fixed or independently re-reviewed.

verified_by_reading: Session uses initialMortalState and resolveMortal for every admitted/refused transition; fixture generation changes initial configuration only.
Command fold replay compares every transition digest and final state; documentation correctly distinguishes this from signed journal verification.

Policies use own HP/maxHP, own known weapon ID, visible acting order and opponent standing/escape status; no numerical enemy HP threshold, secret seed inspection or future draw selection was found. They access host state directly, so a future policy API taking ActorView would make this discipline structural, but current predicates use available facts.

Health classification is explicit: hp>0 standing, hp==0 unconscious, hp<0 dead; escape requires admitted retreat plus standing actor; victory requires terminated encounter, no retreat and incapacitated foes.
Common seeds/initial HP draws are paired across arms; separate train/holdout/pilot domains and no hidden random rerolls found.
Declared primary targets use unarmored single-raider cells; armor and outnumbered cells are reported separately.
Wilson and paired mean/sample-variance math match independent ordinary-case calculations; TARGET_Z correctly represents four one-sided Bonferroni target bounds.
Trial count500 per arm/partition is explicitly preregistered; no adaptive stopping in runStudy. Pilot discards outcomes and retains timings/counts.

Holdout CLI binds the exact training report/decision, source fingerprint and trial count; holdout produces no new selected recommendation. File-exclusive artifacts are process evidence, not cryptographic prevention of an analyst fabricating inputs or rerunning under another filename.
Finite resource scenarios follow legal commands, do not patch HP/clocks after initialization, retain refusal counters, and separate stock depletion from missed due payments.

execution.math_only_probes: Independent Wilson50/100, paired four-observation variance, boundary samples and synthetic censored comparison

scope_limit: No train/holdout outcomes inspected; no review of the eventual empirical recommendation or revised fingerprint.
